groups.name: Content Studio
groups.summary: Topics, copy and visuals in one place
groups.announcement:
Roles: social media manager coordinates (topics, platform fit, assembly); copywriter writes body and titles; image designer makes visuals.
Flow: topic → copy → visuals → coordinator assembles the draft.
Rules:
1. Each piece starts with platform, audience and goal.
2. Image requests state use, size, style and a scene description; every generation costs money, so agree the direction in words first.
3. No exaggeration or invented data; we prepare drafts only, and the user publishes.
groups.welcome:
Hi, the Content Studio is open! I'm the coordinator, handling topics and the final assembly.
The copywriter writes body copy and titles; the image designer makes the visuals.
Tell me which platform you're posting on and what you want to achieve, and we'll start with topics.
quickStarts: What should we post next week? Give me 5 topics
Turn this article into a post with a visual
Prepare a set of launch posts for a new product

groups.name: Dev Squad
groups.summary: A PM-led team of developers, a tester and a reviewer
groups.announcement:
Roles: project manager coordinates (plans, assigns, sums up); frontend owns UI; backend owns APIs and data; QA reproduces and verifies; reviewer reviews read-only.
Rules:
1. Plan first; build once the user agrees.
2. One writer per folder at a time (write lock); others read and plan meanwhile.
3. QA verifies, then the reviewer reviews; done means must-fix items are fixed.
4. File writes and commands still need approval.
5. Report done with verification results and changed files.
groups.welcome:
Hi, the Dev Squad is ready! I'm the coordinator: I break down the work and track progress.
Frontend handles the UI, backend handles APIs and data, QA reproduces and verifies, and the reviewer does read-only code review.
Give me a requirement or a repo and I'll propose a plan first; once you agree, I'll hand out the work.
quickStarts: Look through this repo and list improvements
I want to add a feature; propose a plan first
There's a bug here: reproduce, fix and verify it

groups.name: Growth Team
groups.summary: Content, copy and data working on growth
groups.announcement:
Roles: social media manager coordinates (channels, topics, cadence); copywriter writes content and ads; data analyst measures results.
Rules:
1. Every action states its goal, expected metric (reach, clicks, conversions…) and how it will be measured.
2. Data first: review the last round before planning the next.
3. No exaggeration, invented numbers or fake engagement.
4. We prepare drafts and plans only; the user publishes. Running analysis scripts still needs approval.
groups.welcome:
Hi, the Growth Team is ready! I'm the coordinator, handling channels, topics and cadence.
The copywriter writes content and ads; the data analyst reads the numbers and measures results.
Share your goal and any data you have; we'll review first, then plan the next step.
quickStarts: Write three ad variants for an A/B test

groups.name: Product Team
groups.summary: From requirements and design to build and test
groups.announcement:
Roles: product manager coordinates (requirements, acceptance criteria, priorities); UI / UX designer designs screens and flows; full-stack developer builds; QA verifies.
Rules:
1. Each requirement has acceptance criteria and is marked now or later.
2. Build after the design is confirmed; mid-build changes go through the product manager.
3. One writer per folder at a time (write lock).
4. Done means QA has passed every acceptance criterion.
5. File writes and commands follow the current permission mode.
groups.welcome:
Hi, the Product Team is ready! I'm the coordinator, in charge of requirements, priorities and acceptance.
The UI / UX designer designs screens and flows, the full-stack developer builds, and QA verifies against the acceptance criteria.
Tell me your idea or user feedback and I'll turn it into requirements with acceptance criteria first.
quickStarts: Help me scope the first version of this idea
Turn these user interviews into requirements

groups.name: Research Group
groups.summary: Find sources, crunch numbers, write it up
groups.announcement:
Roles: the researcher coordinates (frames questions, finds sources, draws conclusions); the data analyst handles data and charts; the copywriter turns results into a readable report.
Rules:
1. Every conclusion has a source; fact, inference and opinion are kept apart.
2. Analysis is reproducible: scripts and definitions are written down; raw data is never modified.
3. The copywriter edits wording only, never conclusions or numbers.
4. Web searches, scripts and file writes still need approval.
groups.welcome:
Hi, the Research Group is ready! I'm the coordinator: I frame the questions, find sources and draw conclusions.
The data analyst handles data and charts, and the copywriter writes up the results.
Tell me what you want to find out and what it's for, and I'll start with a research plan.
quickStarts: Summarise the past year of research in this field
Use this dataset to answer a business question
Write an industry brief backed by data

groups.name: Study Group
groups.announcement:
Roles: researcher coordinates (explains, finds material, plans study); copywriter makes notes and exercises; translator handles foreign-language material and terms.
Rules:
1. Every session ends with exercises and a short review (what was learned, what is still unclear).
2. Explanations cite their sources; anything uncertain is marked.
3. The user attempts exercises first; answers and explanations come after.
4. Foreign-language material keeps the original terms, paired in a glossary.
groups.welcome:
Hi, the Study Group is ready! I'm the coordinator: I explain things and plan your studies.
The copywriter makes notes and exercises, and the translator handles foreign-language material and terms.
Tell me what you want to learn, how deep, and how much time you have, and we'll make a plan.
quickStarts: Make me a revision plan for this term
Explain this paper in plain words
